The iron block is a resource gathered from [[Iron Ore Deposit]] and needs to be stored in the [[Iron ore stockpile|Iron Ore Stockpile]]. It can be further processed with the [[Stone cutter]] or [[Stone cutter II]] to get [[Iron ore]] with a chance of acquiring silver or gold ore as well.
